claim_boundary.purpose: minimum structured conical-probe acquisition using CAD-seeded offsets rebased to measured M12/M10/M8 as-built centres
claim_boundary.not_a_robot_pose_plan: local offsets must first be rebased to the measured as-built socket centre, then transformed by a separately measured and qualified fixture-to-WORLD transform
claim_boundary.label_policy: CAD centres are initial guesses only; measured touchdown and measured as-built centre define labels; centre samples carry no direction label and are not included
claim_boundary.data_governance: only clean candidates may become training data after complete cone/force/frame/label quality gates; holdout, quarantine, and sentinel attempts are never independent training samples

photo_top_view.view_direction: viewer is on +Z_F looking along -Z_F; +Z_F points out of the fixture top plane toward the viewer
photo_top_view.image_pixel_mapping: u_pixel_right is proportional to -x_fixture; v_pixel_down is proportional to +y_fixture
photo_top_view.qualification: the displayed-axis mapping fixes handedness for the schematic only; it is not a calibrated camera homography

sentinel.semantics: exact repeats of two clean-candidate coordinates for drift/repeatability monitoring

geometry_mm.sampling_visual_bound_source: max(visual_offset_sweep_m); the reviewed 5/6/8 mm values are not visual_offset_default_m
